q: A visual art form that creates three-dimensional (3D) objects having height, width, and depth is ____. (P6)
explain: Sculptures occupy real 3D physical volume in space.

q: The technique of depicting three-dimensional depth and distance on a flat 2D surface is called ____. (P6)
explain: Perspective uses vanishing points and scale to create realistic depth illusions.
hint: Technique for depth on flat surfaces.

q: The legal right granted to an artist or author preventing unauthorized reproduction of their creative work is ____. (P6)
explain: Copyright safeguards original intellectual and creative properties.

q: Famous Yoruba cultural festival celebrated in Lagos featuring white-clad masquerades with tall staffs is the ____ festival. (P6)
explain: Eyo festival is a historic royal cultural pageant in Lagos Island.
hint: Lagos masquerade with white flowing robes.

q: The grand equestrian (horseback) cultural festival celebrated across Northern Nigerian emirates during Eid is the ____. (P6)
explain: The Durbar displays regal cavalry, traditional music, and emirate pageantry.
hint: Grand horse riding festival in Northern Nigeria.

q: Traditional instrument (P6): What is a Talking drum (Gangan / Kalangu)?
options: an hourglass-shaped drum whose pitch changes by squeezing leather cords
explain: The Talking drum (Gangan / Kalangu) is an hourglass-shaped drum whose pitch changes by squeezing leather cords.

q: Traditional instrument (P6): What is a Kakaki?
options: a very long metal royal trumpet used in Northern Nigerian ceremonies
explain: The Kakaki is a very long metal royal trumpet used in Northern Nigerian ceremonies.

q: Traditional instrument (P6): What is a Shekere?
options: a dried gourd covered with a woven bead net shaken for rhythm
explain: The Shekere is a dried gourd covered with a woven bead net shaken for rhythm.

q: Traditional instrument (P6): What is a Ogene?
options: a traditional forged iron double-bell gong played in Igbo music
explain: The Ogene is a traditional forged iron double-bell gong played in Igbo music.

q: Traditional instrument (P6): What is a Goje?
options: a traditional one- or two-stringed bowed fiddle with a gourd resonator
explain: The Goje is a traditional one- or two-stringed bowed fiddle with a gourd resonator.

q: Traditional instrument (P6): What is a Udu?
options: a water jug clay vessel drum tapped to produce deep bass tones
explain: The Udu is a water jug clay vessel drum tapped to produce deep bass tones.
